title: 第13章 这小伙好俊俏
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “南瓜还有一些。你要多少？”辰楠笑了笑，难道这人要很多不成？想到空间小世界里面的南瓜，很快就可以变现了呢。“你这南瓜味道很不错。”刀疤男并没有询问这是从哪儿搞来的南瓜，问了也注定得不到答案。谁还没点秘密，啥都要问就是不礼貌。辰楠笑了笑没说话，他自然知道自家的南瓜味道很不错。“一万斤有没有？“刀疤男突然报出一个惊人的数字，眼睛紧紧盯着辰楠的反应。这个数量让辰楠心中一愣。一万斤南瓜。若是让自已散卖，不知道得卖到什么时候才能卖完。可如果有人大量购买，那他薄利多销也是可以的，如此一来能省下很多时间。这刀疤男或许是在试探，但这何尝不是一个机会呢。艺高人胆大的他也不怕刀疤男搞什么小动作。“外面还有一千斤。“辰楠不慌不忙地说，“想要一万斤，得过几天才能运过来。“这番话既表明了实力，又留有余地。刀疤男眼中闪过一丝震惊，这年轻人确实不简单。一万斤南瓜也有，其背后应该还有人。虽说南瓜不是主食，但粮食紧缺也能填饱肚子。刀疤男身体微微前倾，“市面上南瓜两三分钱一斤，还要副食票。但现在这光景，黑市上的价格会高过市面上。“辰楠点点头，由于三年特殊时期导致粮食紧缺，黑市上的物价已经高得离谱。普通南瓜平时只卖两三分钱，现在却能卖到几毛以上，还常常有价无市。“你刚才也知道我以物换物的价格，南瓜在三毛二一斤。”辰楠报出一个价格，他相信刀疤男肯定知道这个价格。刀疤男笑了，脸上的刀疤随之扭曲，“小伙子，量大从优的道理你不懂？一口价，一毛八。““两毛二。“辰楠寸步不让，“这么大的南瓜，整个四九城都找不出第二家。而且...“他故意顿了顿，“这南瓜特别甜，保证好吃。”刀疤男吃过，的确是好吃，他表示从未吃过如此美味的南瓜。“一万斤的量太大，量大从优，你看两毛钱如何？”“如果你以后还有货，都可以来找我。”刀疤男不仅只看眼前的利益，他看得更长远。投机倒把的他非常了解如今的粮食状况。现在市面上到处都缺粮食，哪怕不是主食也能填饱肚子。虽然南瓜不是主食，但南瓜与别的面食混合在一起却是可以当主食！如果省着点吃，一只百斤的南瓜与少量的面食搅拌成南瓜饼，无疑可以养活一家三口一个月！当然，一个月都吃南瓜饼也不行，这只是一个举例。不过，若是饿得连野菜树皮都要吃的时候，吃一个月的南瓜饼似乎并没有什么不好。那时候想吃一顿南瓜饼反而成了一种奢求。“那就按你说的这个价。”南瓜的价格最终以两毛钱一斤成交。对这个价格，辰楠其实还是挺满意的。要知道，这一万斤南瓜若是散卖，不仅费时费力，还容易惹人注意。主要他也没那么多时间。如今一次性出手，虽然单价低了点，但省事又安全。“合作愉快。”刀疤男满脸笑意。最近他一直在收粮食，可实在是找不到卖家。如今很少有人有粮食，家里有粮食的人都不往外卖粮食。“今天先交一千斤给你，剩下的三天后交货，“辰楠想了想报出一个位置，“就后海外面那片树林。”“可以。”刀疤男应了下来。后海树林离这里并不远，也比较偏僻，刚好适合交易。“三天后，后海外边的小树林。“刀疤男声音低沉，“丑时交易，过时不候。“辰楠点头表示同意，这个时间点选得巧妙，正是夜深人静之时，后海那片树林平时就人迹罕至，这个时辰更是连个鬼影都见不着。让辰楠意外的是，刀疤男说完便朝身后打了个手势。一个马仔立即捧出一个木盒子，打开盖子，里面整整齐齐码放着一叠崭新的钞票。“这是一千斤南瓜的两百块钱。“刀疤男示意马仔将钱递给辰楠，“剩下的，货到付款。“辰楠接过钱，指尖触碰到钞票光滑的质感。这是十块钱一张的‘大团结’，是这个时代面值最大的钱。二十张“大团结“，在这个普通工人月薪只有三四十块的年代，确实是一笔不小的数目。但他面色平静，只是简单清点了一下就揣进兜里，（实则丢到空间小世界里）仿佛接过的不是巨款，而是寻常物件。这番镇定自若的表现，让刀疤男眼中闪过一丝赞赏。他见过太多人第一次拿到这么多钱时失态的模样，有的手抖，有的眼直，更有甚者当场就数了一遍又一遍。可眼前这个年轻人，却像是见过大世面的。“小哥好定力。“刀疤男难得地夸了一句。“刀哥说笑了。”辰楠有点想笑，不就是两百元吗？若是两个亿他还能激动一番。交易谈妥，气氛顿时轻松了许多。刀疤男甚至让人给辰楠倒了杯茶——在这年头，茶叶可是稀罕物。此举也想要掀开眼前之人的面罩，眼前这人脸上还蒙着脸呢。辰楠瞥了刀疤男一眼，自然知道他想做什么。估计以后要长期合作，坦诚一点他也不在意。他作为一个有点实力的人，自然不会在意这点小事。他直接掀开面罩，端起茶水就抿了一口。“这普洱茶的味道不错。”好久没喝茶的辰楠，只觉得一股醇香在舌尖跳动。“小哥真年轻。”刀疤男有些傻眼，没想到面罩下的少年如此年轻，看样子都还未成年。还以为这少年郎不敢摘下面罩，谁知人家是真敢，可见人家是一点都不害怕他们这群地头蛇。其余马仔也是一副见鬼的神色，这不摘下面罩，他们绝对想象不到面罩下竟然是一张如此年轻的脸。小伙子五官端正，剑眉星目，目光炯炯有神，第一眼的感觉就像个柔弱书生，俊美帅气的容貌带着一丝苍白。这小伙好俊俏。他们的脑海自主浮现出那句话——陌上人如玉，公子世无双。
content_en: "There are still some pumpkins. How many do you want?" Chen Nan smiled, does this person want a lot?Thinking of the pumpkins in the small world of space, they can be realized soon."Your pumpkin tastes very good." The scarred man didn't ask where he got the pumpkin from, and he was bound to get no answer if he asked.It's rude to ask anyone who doesn't have a secret yet.Chen Nan smiled and said nothing. He naturally knew that his pumpkin tasted very good."Is it ten thousand pounds?" The scarred man suddenly reported an astonishing number, his eyes fixed on Chen Nan's reaction.This amount made Chen Nan stunned.Ten thousand pounds of pumpkin.If I sell them in bulk, I don’t know how long it will take to sell them all.But if someone buys in large quantities, it is okay for him to make small profits but quick turnover, which can save a lot of time.The scarred man may be testing, but this is not an opportunity.Being a brave man, he is not afraid of the little tricks of the scarred man."There are still one thousand kilograms outside." Chen Nan said calmly, "If you want ten thousand kilograms, it will take a few days to transport it." These words not only showed the strength, but also left room for room.There was a flash of shock in the scarred man's eyes. This young man was indeed not simple.There are also 10,000 kilograms of pumpkins, and there must be people behind them.Although pumpkin is not a staple food, it can fill the stomach even if food is scarce.The scarred man leaned forward slightly, "On the market, pumpkins cost two or three cents per pound, and they require food stamps. But in this situation, the price on the black market will be higher than the market price." Chen Nan nodded. Due to the food shortage caused by the three-year special period, the prices on the black market have become ridiculously high.Ordinary pumpkins usually only cost two or three cents, but now they can be sold for more than a few cents, and they are often sold at high prices but not in the market."You just knew the price of my barter. The pumpkin is 30.20 pounds." Chen Nan quoted a price, and he believed that the scarred man must know this price.The scarred man smiled, and the scar on his face twisted, "Young man, you don't understand the principle of giving priority to large quantities? The price is only 18 cents." "Twenty-two cents." Chen Nan refused to budge, "There is no other pumpkin of this size in the entire Sijiu City. And..." He paused deliberately, "This pumpkin is very sweet, guaranteed to be delicious." The scarred man has eaten it, and it is indeed delicious. He said that he has never eaten such a delicious pumpkin."Ten thousand kilograms is too much. Larger quantities will give you better prices. What do you think of two cents?" "If you still have goods in the future, you can come to me." The scarred man not only looks at the immediate benefits, he also takes a longer-term view.As a speculator, he is very familiar with the current food situation.Nowadays, there is a shortage of food everywhere in the market, even if it is not a staple food, it can fill the stomach.Although pumpkin is not a staple food, pumpkin can be a staple food when mixed with other pasta!If you eat sparingly, a hundred pounds of pumpkin mixed with a small amount of pasta to make pumpkin pie can undoubtedly feed a family of three for a month!Of course, eating pumpkin pie for a month is not enough. This is just an example.However, if you are so hungry that you even want to eat wild vegetable bark, there seems to be nothing wrong with eating pumpkin pie for a month.At that time, wanting to eat pumpkin pie became a luxury."Then I'll pay the price you said." The pumpkin was finally sold at two cents a pound.Chen Nan is actually quite satisfied with the price.You know, if these 10,000 kilograms of pumpkins are sold in bulk, it will not only be time-consuming and labor-intensive, but also easy to attract attention.Mainly, he doesn't have that much time.Nowadays, it is a one-time purchase. Although the unit price is a bit lower, it is easy and safe."It's a pleasure to cooperate." The scarred man said with a smile on his face.He has been collecting grain recently, but he really can't find a seller.Nowadays, few people have food, and those who have food at home do not take out food."I'll hand you one thousand kilograms today, and the rest will be delivered in three days." Chen Nan thought for a while and reported a location, "Just in the woods outside Houhai." "Okay." The scarred man agreed.Houhai Forest is not far from here and is relatively remote, which is just suitable for trading."Three days later, in the woods outside Houhai." The scarred man's voice was low, "Trade when it's ugly, don't wait when it's bad." Chen Nan nodded in agreement. This time was chosen cleverly. It was in the dead of night, and the woods in Houhai were usually sparsely visited. At this hour, not even a ghost could be seen.What surprised Chen Nan was that after the scarred man finished speaking, he gestured behind him.A horseman immediately took out a wooden box and opened the lid. There was a stack of brand new banknotes neatly stacked inside."This is two hundred yuan for one thousand kilograms of pumpkins." The scarred man motioned to Ma Zai to hand the money to Chen Nan, "The rest is cash on delivery." Chen Nan took the money and touched the smooth texture of the banknotes with her fingertips.This is the "Great Unity" worth ten yuan a piece, which is the largest face value of money in this era.Twenty "Great Unity" cards were indeed a large sum of money in this era when the monthly salary of ordinary workers was only thirty or forty yuan.But his face was calm, and he simply counted it and put it into his pocket (actually throwing it into the small world of space), as if what he had received was not a huge sum of money, but an ordinary object.This calm and composed performance made the scarred man's eyes flash with admiration.He had seen too many people lose their composure when they got so much money for the first time. Some had shaking hands, some had straight eyes, and some even counted them over and over on the spot.But the young man in front of him seemed to have seen the world."Brother, you are so calm." The scarred man gave a rare compliment."Brother Dao is joking." Chen Nan wanted to laugh. Isn't it just two hundred yuan?If it was 200 million, he would still be excited.After the deal was concluded, the atmosphere suddenly became much more relaxed.The scarred man even had someone pour Chen Nan a cup of tea - tea was a rare thing these days.This move also wanted to lift the mask of the person in front of him, whose face was still covered.Chen Nan glanced at the scarred man and naturally knew what he wanted to do.It is estimated that we will have a long-term cooperation in the future, and he doesn't care if he is honest.As a man of some strength, he naturally wouldn't care about such a trivial matter.He directly opened his mask, picked up the tea and took a sip."This Pu'er tea tastes good." Chen Nan, who hadn't drank tea for a long time, felt a mellow aroma dancing on the tip of his tongue."Brother is so young." The scarred man was a little dumbfounded. He didn't expect that the boy under the mask was so young. He looked like he was still underage.I thought that this young man didn't dare to take off his mask, but he really did. It shows that he is not afraid of these local cowards at all.The other horses also looked like they had seen a ghost. Unless they took off their masks, they would never have imagined that there was such a young face under the mask.The young man has regular features, sword-shaped eyebrows, and piercing eyes. At first glance, he looks like a weak scholar, with a hint of paleness in his handsome appearance.This guy is so handsome.That sentence appeared in their minds - the stranger is like jade, and the young master is unparalleled in the world.
